about_the_game:
Capture Nexus is a charming single-player capture-the-flag game built for relaxing, feel-good fun. This minimalist adventure invites you into a vibrant arena filled with lively colors and cheerful music, where your goal is to grab the other team’s flag and bring it home. Perfect for a quick, joyful escape, it’s easy to pick up and packed with happy vibes.

How It Works

As a member of the Red team, you face AI-controlled Blue team members. The arena is split by portals, each leading to an identical map: one for your base, one for the Blue team. Find a key to unlock the middle ground gates from the arena-playground, get the Blue team's flag, and race back to your base to win. Spot a member from the other team? Click on them to toss a trap ball, catching them in a playful snare. With simple controls and a stress-free pace, it’s all about enjoying the moment.

Why Play Capture Nexus?

  • Joyful Simplicity: A straightforward, relaxing experience for all skill levels.

  • Vibrant Visuals: Bright, lively colors bring the arena to life.

  • Cheerful Music: A soothing soundtrack keeps the mood light.

  • Playful Mechanics: Toss trap balls and zip through portals in a fun flag chase.

  • Easy Navigation: An in-game menu makes jumping in a breeze.

What’s Included?

Capture Nexus offers a single, colorful arena with portals linking identical Red and Blue team maps. Enjoy a solo adventure with AI opponents, trap balls, and a relaxing capture-the-flag challenge. It’s a short, happy burst of fun! Get ready to smile, chase flags, and soak in the color and music!

  • OS *: Windows 8 or newer

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 7500M/7600M Series
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-7300HQ CPU @ 2.50GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
